description: This Japanese Nissin Spicy Donbei Kitsune Udon features broad, flat udon noodles and distinctively soft, chewy fried tofu in a red-hot broth. The rich, oily soup blends pork, shoyu, and katsuo dashi with a balanced level of spice, offering a compelling and unique flavor profile for a Japanese udon.

variety: Super Gattai Original Cup Noodle & Shio
description: This Japanese Nissin Super Gattai Cup Noodle combines their Original and Shio flavors, offering an exquisite and addictive broth. Its distinctive profile features dominant smoked olive notes harmoniously balanced with the familiar hint of pepper soy sauce.

Nissin's Taisho Fried Noodle Yakisoba delivers a classic Japanese yakisoba experience, focusing on its distinctive chewy noodles and savory, albeit slightly dry, sauce profile, without additional ingredients.
This Japanese Nissin Donbei variety offers thick, chewy udon noodles in a regional Hakata-style dashi broth, complemented by sweet-savory fried tofu pockets.

Nissin's Japanese Togarashi Men Umakara Tomato & Cheese Cup Noodle offers thin, flat noodles in a broth featuring a spicy tomato and cheese melange, subtly enhanced with a hint of togarashi for a gentle warmth.

This Japanese Nissin Tokyo Abura Soba delivers a high-end, soupless ramen experience featuring exceptionally chewy noodles coated in a thick, savory sauce of soy sauce and pork lard. It is distinctively enhanced by a creamy egg seasoning and a vibrant garnish of crunchy spring onions, seaweed, and sesame.

This Japanese Nissin Tokyo Tokunou Gyokai Tonkotsu delivers a rich, thick broth that expertly balances savory pork with distinct seafood notes. It features satisfyingly chewy noodles, complemented by unique, flavorful onion bits and tender chashu pork.

variety: Tongarashi Ramen Sweet & Spicy Tomato Cream & Cheese
description: This Japanese cup noodle features a distinctive thick, creamy tomato soup broth with a delicious cheese flavor and a subtle spicy kick. Its interesting noodles create an unexpectedly satisfying combination.

This Japanese tray-style yakisoba features thick kamaage egg noodles coated in a sweet, gentle sauce reminiscent of an okonomiyaki restaurant, distinct from sharp Worcestershire, and includes cabbage, seasoned pork, and squid.

variety: U. F. O. 3 Cheese Gyudon Yakisoba
description: This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. yakisoba features standard noodles coated in a gyudon-inspired sauce, uniquely topped with a 3-cheese mayo (Edam, Parmesan, Romano) that combines for a distinctive flavor profile of tangy acidity and beefy, somewhat funky notes.

variety: U. F. O. BIG Wasabi-Mayo Yakisoba
description: Nissin's U.F.O. BIG Wasabi-Mayo Yakisoba is a substantial Japanese stir-fried noodle dish, featuring chewy wheat noodles coated in a savory yakisoba sauce and distinctly finished with a creamy, pungent wasabi-mayo for a bold flavor experience.

variety: U.F.O. Abura Soba w/Chili Oil Mayo
description: This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Abura Soba offers a distinctive soup-less ramen experience with thick, chewy noodles coated in a delicious, rich shoyu tare. Its unique "flare" comes from the generous addition of chili oil mayonnaise, creating an oily and satisfyingly flavorful combination.

This unique Japanese Nissin U.F.O. cup yakisoba delivers an intensely buttery flavor, reminiscent of movie theater popcorn, complemented by the subtle briny notes of cod roe (tarako). Served sauceless with shrimp, salmon, and pork, it offers a bold and distinctive take on classic yakisoba.

This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Koi Yakisoba offers springy noodles coated in a rich, "Koi" Worcestershire-like sauce deepened with kelp and shiitake. It's distinguished by a generous mix of fresh cabbage, crispy deep-fried batter bits, and savory bonito fish flakes, providing a complex texture and flavor profile.

variety: U.F.O. Koikoi Seafood BBQ Fu Yakisoba
description: This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Koikoi Seafood BBQ Fu Yakisoba offers nicely textured noodles coated in a great Seafood BBQ sauce, distinguished by its notably good-sized and quality pieces of shrimp, pork, chicken, and squid. As a tray-style yakisoba, it focuses on these savory fried noodles and rich toppings rather than a broth.

This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. yakisoba offers a rich, distinctive flavor profile with charred soy sauce, creamy butter, and prominent cod roe (tarako) and seafood notes. It features thicker-gauge, soft, and almost sticky noodles that soak up the intense seasoning.

variety: U.F.O. Rayu Mayo Soy Sauce Mazesoba
description: This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Mazesoba offers thick, abura soba-style noodles coated in a savory soy sauce base, distinctly augmented by a spicy chili mayo for a bold, sauced noodle experience.

variety: U.F.O. Slurp! Flavor Punch! Extra Thick Sauce Yakisoba
description: This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Yakisoba stands out with its signature thick, tangy Worcestershire-esque and tamarindy sauce that delivers a "flavor punch" to its slightly thicker noodles. This distinctive Japanese tray noodle is further enhanced by ample cabbage, beef bits, and a sachet of seaweed and red ginger.

This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Yakisoba features a wonderfully flavorful liquid yakisoba sauce, complemented by rehydrated dried meat, veggies, and a distinctive powdered seaweed topping. While the noodles are noted as somewhat mushy, the robust overall flavor profile creates an enjoyable classic stir-fried noodle experience.

This Japanese Nissin U.F.O. Yakisoba White offers thick, satisfying noodles characteristic of the brand's tray-style yakisoba. Its savory flavor profile is distinctly enhanced by a slightly stronger, almost tamarind-like note, complemented by chicken, pork, and a touch of shichimi.

variety: UFO Pokkmyeon Koi Koi Kankoku Fu Amakara Carbo
description: This Japanese Nissin UFO yakisoba features thick, wavy, and chewy noodles coated in a distinctive Korean-style 'carbo' sauce. This rich, sweet, and spicy preparation blends savory chicken umami with the kick of gochujang and the mellow richness of cheese for a complex flavor.

This Japanese Nissin UFO Yakisoba features abundant, fluffy noodles coated in a classic Worcestershire-style sauce, uniquely distinguished by a zesty wasabi mayonnaise that adds a memorable kick. Complemented by savory seaweed sprinkles and mixed vegetables, it delivers a rich, flavorful, and characteristically satisfying noodle dish.

This Japanese Nissin Ultraman instant noodle cup features a notably rich and milky pork broth, which is its standout flavor. While the very thin noodles may require extra steeping time for optimal texture, the savory broth makes it a distinctive experience.

This Japanese Nissin V.F.O. Katsu Soba Yakisoba features chewy, stir-fried style noodles coated in a savory sauce. Distinctively, its "Katsu" name refers to "victory" rather than a traditional meat cutlet, offering a satisfying, meat-free twist on the classic instant yakisoba.

This Japanese Nissin Wakayama Ramen, a heavier style, boasts a deliciously thick and luxuriant pork bone broth, expertly balanced by a tangy soy sauce seasoning. Its noodles provide an excellent, enjoyable chew, complemented by a distinctive colorful naruto fish cake.
This Japanese Nissin Yakisoba, presented in a tray, is now noted for omitting the distinctive mayonnaise and mustard pack that previously complemented its savory noodle profile so well.

This Japanese Nissin Yakisoba pack offers soft, chewy noodles coated in a classic sweet and Worcestershire-infused sauce, delivering the quintessential yakisoba flavor, enhanced by a savory seaweed topping.
This Japanese Nissin Yakisoba tray features satisfying noodles and perfectly rehydrated cabbage, expertly coated in a savory sauce and finished with a distinctive, zesty wasabi-infused mayonnaise.

variety: Yakisoba U.F.O. Perori Katsuo Dashi Sauce Yakisoba
description: This Japanese Nissin Yakisoba U.F.O. cup noodle features well-textured, drained noodles coated in a distinctive Katsuo Dashi sauce, offering a bold flavor profile that some may find notably salty.

variety: Yakisoba U.F.O. Pokkunmyon Korean-style Sweet & Spicy Carbonara Creamy
description: This Japanese Nissin Yakisoba U.F.O. features thick, chewy noodles in a unique creamy carbonara-style sauce, offering a delightful blend of sweet cheese flavor and a building Korean sweet and spicy heat.

This Japanese tray-style instant yakisoba is distinctive for its inclusion of authentic Japanese mayonnaise. Made with apple cider or rice vinegar and a touch of MSG, this essential topping is noted for significantly enhancing the overall flavor profile with its unique tangy and umami qualities.

This Nissin instant noodle from Thailand features a Tom Yum broth, described as having a perplexing slightly bitter finish, complementing standard gauge noodles with a light chewiness. It is distinctively accented by nice supplied seafood bits, including shrimp.

This Japanese Nissin Iekei Ramen offers high-quality, fresh-feeling noodles in a milky, rich tonkotsu and miso-style broth, distinctively enhanced by chicken fat for extra body and character. Generous garnishes of vegetables, meat, and nori complement this savory bowl.

Nongshim Fururu Cold Noodles offer a refreshing Japanese take on Korean bibim style, featuring thin noodles with an interesting chew. These are coated in a distinctive sweet, sour, and spicy gochujang-based sauce, creating a premium and flavorful cold meal with a pleasant kick.

This Japanese cup ramen offers a distinctive Korean-style hot chili soup that is notably hot, tasty, and features a subtle bitter note. Its thick, slightly spongy noodles effectively soak up the flavorful broth, which is complemented by shiitake mushroom, green onion, and carrot.

This Japanese Nissin Donbei Curry Udon features chewy noodles in a very saucy, fragrant curry broth crafted from a delicious dashi stock with notes of cumin and garlic, complemented by tasty fried tofu and meaty bits.
This Japanese instant shio ramen is a revisited classic, offering exceptionally chewy noodles that cook quickly, complemented by a clean, tasty broth subtly highlighted with sesame notes.

This revisited Japanese classic, Ogasawara Kirin Giraffe Shoyu Ramen, offers "nice and happy" noodles complemented by a remarkably tasty and "top notch" shoyu broth, impressive for its quality from a single powder sachet.

This Japanese Oguro Shokuhin AKAGI Niboshi Chuka Soba features thin, firm noodles served in a sharp, clean soy sauce broth deeply infused with flavorful dried sardines (niboshi). This distinctive bowl is complemented by savory toppings like chashu, egg, fu, and green onion, which readily absorb its unique essence.
This Japanese Oyatsu Baby Star Ramen Round Chikinmini is a ready-to-eat ramen snack, featuring crunchy, bite-sized pieces that deliver a distinctive salty and slightly sweet flavor.

variety: Baby Star Ramen Round Consomme Mini
description: This Japanese Oyatsu Baby Star Ramen is a distinctive crunchy snack, featuring bite-sized round pieces with a savory-sweet flavor profile, enhanced by chicken bouillon and reminiscent of yakisoba. It's designed for direct snacking, offering a satisfying crisp texture and rich taste without a broth.

variety: Baby Star Snack Noodle Chicken Flavour
description: This Japanese Oyatsu Baby Star Snack Noodle offers a distinctive dry snack experience with a light, pleasant crunch and a unique savory flavor profile reminiscent of sesame chicken.

variety: Baby Star Snack Noodle Yakisoba Flavor
description: The Oyatsu Baby Star Snack Noodle is a distinctive Japanese dry snack featuring light, crunchy short noodle lengths. It delivers a savory yakisoba flavor profile, characterized by notes of Worcestershire sauce, salt, and spices for a perfectly seasoned bite.

This Paldo Shoyu cup ramen, a traditional Japanese soy sauce style made for the Japanese market, features thin, decent noodles. Its broth delivers a very nice, distinctive soy flavor and aroma, complemented by decently rehydrated vegetables.

This Paldo Teumsae instant noodle, a Japanese version of a classic Korean style, features thick, chewy noodles that perfectly cradle its seriously spicy, flavor-packed broth. It delivers an intense and robust heat experience.

This Japanese Peyang Cho-Omori Yakisoba is a distinctive, large-format instant meal featuring two full-sized portions in separate compartments: a classic original flavor and a super spicy Gekikara. It delivers double the noodles, complemented by mixed vegetables, seaweed, sesame, and white pepper for a customizable stir-fried experience.

Peyang Yakisoba from Japan features light, bouncy fried noodles coated in a classic sweet, salty, and Worcestershire-based sauce that is neither oily nor overbearing. This tray-style dish is further distinguished by a satisfying variety of crunchy vegetables, elegantly complemented by a finishing sprinkle of seaweed and white pepper.

variety: Extra Extra Extra Extra Extra Extra Large Portion Yakisoba Petamax
description: This Japanese Peyoung Yakisoba Petamax is an enormous, extra-large portion instant noodle, distinctively presented in a mammoth tray that emphasizes its remarkably generous size.

The Japanese Peyoung Gekkikara MAX END yakisoba features thin, somewhat crumbly noodles coated in a sauce primarily characterized by an intense, extract-based heat. While delivering a decent spice kick, its flavor profile is noted to be less developed beyond the strong heat element.
This Japanese Peyoung Gigamax Yakisoba is an uniquely enormous tray-style instant noodle, explicitly designed for its colossal scale and perfect for sharing among family.

Peyoung's Japanese Hell Curry Yakisoba features light, fluffy noodles coated in a distinctively "funky" curry sauce that delivers a good level of spiciness. This saucy dish is accompanied by cabbage and meat.

Peyoung's Japanese Ikasumi Yakisoba offers an innovative take on classic stir-fried noodles with its distinctive squid ink flavor. This tray-style dish features spongy noodles coated in a tasty yet notably salty sauce, complete with generous toppings of squid, garlic, and cabbage.

This Japanese Peyoung yakisoba offers a unique take on Kyushu tonkotsu, featuring thin, "barikata" crunchy noodles that cook in just one minute. Its authentic pork bone sauce is robust, complemented by sharp mustard and pickled ginger for a distinctive flavor experience.

This Japanese Peyoung Noodle is a nostalgic, light soy sauce-based bowl, distinctive for its thin, soft noodles seasoned with sesame that also infuse its gentle, peppery broth, and generous toppings of fragrant shrimp and seasoned minced chicken.

This Japanese Peyoung Phakchi Lemon Ramen delivers a distinctive and refreshing flavor profile, prominently featuring *phakchi* (coriander) complemented by bright lemon notes, including a subtle bitterness from lemon peel. It comes with thin noodles that have a unique slight rigidity and crumble.

Ripe'n'Dry's Hokkaido Miso Ramen from Japan is a highly sought-after variety, celebrated for its distinctive and satisfying miso flavor that reviewers significantly prefer over the brand's shio offering.

This Japanese Ripe'n'Dry Hokkaido Salt Ramen offers noodles with a strong backbone, good chew, and a slight crumble. Its distinctive broth features a unique bitter saltiness that elicits mixed feelings.

This Japanese Hokkaido Soy Sauce Ramen, a shoyu style, features a distinctive chewy noodle texture and a clear brown broth. Known for its tangy, salty, and savory soy sauce flavor profile, the broth remains fairly light on the palate.

From Japan, Sakurai's vegetarian instant noodles promise a savory, umami-rich experience. Expect a clean, delicately flavored broth, likely derived from vegetables and mushrooms, accompanying classic springy noodles.

This Japanese instant yakisoba, a unique Nissin collaboration with Korean Hot Chicken Flavor Ramen, features thick, flat noodles coated in a sweet and spicy sauce reminiscent of yangnyeom chicken, complemented by cheddar and gouda cheese flavors for a distinct and complex profile.

This Sakurai Foods' ARCHE Naturküche Japanische Nudelsuppe features distinctively thin yet dense, chewy noodles complemented by a strong, flavorful broth with prominent notes of ginger and hints of miso, enhanced by its unique liquid seasoning.

This Sakurai Foods Japanese instant ramen offers nicely textured noodles and a dark, liquid broth boasting a strong, deep flavor with an inherent ginger note, consistent with its natural cuisine style.
This Japanese Sakurai Foods ramen features satisfyingly solid noodles paired with a light, dainty broth, offering a mild flavor profile that invites personal customization.

This Japanese Sakurai Foods Miso Ramen delivers a deeply rich miso broth alongside soft, light potato starch noodles made from Hokkaido flour. It's complemented by a diverse selection of vegetables, creating a satisfying and flavorful bowl.
This Japanese instant udon offers a satisfying winter-style stew experience, featuring wide, flat, and firm noodles bathed in a deep yet balanced miso broth that isn't too strong.

Sakurai Foods' Japanese Organic Miso Ramen features thick, satisfyingly chewy noodles enveloped in a deeply colored broth that delivers a very luxuriant and aromatic miso flavor. It stands out as a distinctive organic and vegan-friendly option.
This organic Japanese Shoyu Ramen from Sakurai Foods offers a savory, umami-rich soy sauce-based broth, characteristic of traditional ramen, served with springy, satisfying wheat noodles.

Sakurai Foods' Japanese Sesame Noodles feature perfectly chewy noodles, crafted with Hokkaido flour, immersed in a luxuriant, deeply flavorful sesame broth that achieves a perfectly balanced, not-overwhelming taste.

This Japanese Sakurai Foods Soy Sauce Ramen bowl features springy noodles crafted with Hokkaido flour and potato starch, swimming in a deep, warming soy broth. A generous mix of vegetables, especially the excellent nori, provides a distinctive seafood essence that weaves throughout the meal.

Hailing from Japan, this Soy Sauce Ramen features light, plentiful noodles with a satisfying chew. Its elegant broth delivers a distinctly buttery and salty profile, rounded out by a seasoning with notes of soy, subtle sweetness, and savory saltiness.

This Japanese Vegetarian Miso Ramen from Sakurai Foods features a super tasty, savory miso broth with a balanced flavor, noted for not being too heavy on the red. Its noodles are praised for their pleasing gauge and satisfying tooth.
This Japanese Sakurai Foods Vegetarian Shoyu Ramen offers a subtle, balanced shoyu broth with a distinctive sesame hit, complementing its good-gauge, slippery noodles.

This Japanese instant ramen from Sakurai Foods features a distinctive vegetarian soymilk broth that is both creamy and visually appealing. The noodles offer a soft, bouncy chew, complementing the well-balanced spiciness of the flavorful broth.

variety: Vegetarian Stir Fried Noodles (Worcestershire Sauce Flavor)
description: Sakurai Foods offers a distinctive Japanese instant vegetarian stir-fried noodle, notable for its savory Worcestershire sauce flavor. The preparation includes a thick, dark liquid sauce and a finishing sachet of powdered seaweed, which promises a unique umami element.

This Japanese Sakurai Foods Vegetarian Tonkotsu Noodle offers a distinctive vegan take on the rich style, featuring soft, well-gauged noodles in a buttery broth that uniquely blends traditional tonkotsu with comforting shio notes.

This Japanese Samurai ramen offers noodles with an excellent gauge and chew, served in a thinner broth characterized by a classic blend of miso, soy sauce, and sesame. It is distinctive for being a healthy, vegan-friendly option, free from MSG, food dyes, and preservatives.

This Japanese instant ramen features thin, round noodles with a premium chew, served in a thick, savory miso-tasting broth. Distinctively vegan and HALAL-friendly, it's finished with a sprinkle of shichimi togarashi for an aromatic complexity.

Samyang's Japanese-market curry noodle delivers a strong, distinctively sweet and non-spicy Japanese curry broth, paired with perfectly hydrated noodles that have a satisfying chew and tender vegetable and textured protein bits.

This Japanese Samyang Seafood Noodle cup features a distinct, light seafood broth with a buttery undertone, complemented by noodles that hydrate to a pleasantly gooey and slightly spongy texture for a genuine seafood experience.
This Japanese San-Iku Gomaaji Ramen offers a broth with a distinctively strong, somewhat funky soy sauce character, notably elevated by an ample, savory scattering of sesame seeds.
This Japanese San-Iku Miso Ramen features good quality, well-hydrated noodles and a straightforward, savory broth with an authentic miso flavor, though it is noted to be a bit simple.

This Japanese San-Iku Shio Ramen is distinctive for its perfectly textured, standard-gauge noodles. These pair seamlessly with a well-balanced, seasoned salt broth, offering a savory and "just right" shio flavor experience in a convenient pack.
This Japanese pack-style Shoyu Ramen features plump, satisfying noodles in a simple yet rich and flavorful shoyu broth, perfect for enjoying at home.

This Japanese Sanpo Spicy Green Pepper Tonkotsu Ramen features a rich, Hakata-style pork bone broth that gains a distinctive peppiness from Kyushu-made spicy green pepper chips, complemented by its well-suited straight noodles. This creates a unique, chili-infused soup experience.
This Japanese bowl ramen offers thin, chewy noodles in an oily, almost tonkotsu-like broth, distinctively garnished with enjoyable pickled ginger and a characteristically heart-shaped slice of pork.
This Japanese Hello Kitty Hakata Shoyutonkotsu ramen features thin, rounded noodles with a delightful firmness, enveloped in a rich, sweet, and savory pork and soy broth accented with sesame seeds.

This Japanese Mentaiko Durum Spaghetti delivers a unique instant pasta experience with perfectly textured noodles deeply infused by a spicy, slightly fishy, crimson mentaiko sauce, further enhanced by seaweed and visible fish roe. It's a surprisingly flavorful and interesting dish that stands out from typical instant noodles.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban 70th Anniversary Goma Miso Ramen is a distinctive bowl ramen featuring a hearty pork and garlic broth, rich with a prominent sesame aroma that expertly balances classic miso. It includes noodles with a satisfying chew and unique toppings like crab-flavored kamaboko, corn, and green onion.

This Sapporo Ichiban Akita Kiritanpo Ramen is a unique Japanese cup noodle inspired by the regional hot pot, featuring a flavorful shoyu broth with notes of burdock root, vegetable umami, and a subtle spice and vinegar kick. It stands out with its distinctive grilled pounded rice sticks (kiritanpo) and savory meatballs, complementing the less-spongy noodles.

Sapporo Ichiban's Japanese Barbeque Yakisoba offers fluffy wheat noodles tossed in a savory BBQ sauce, distinctly flavored with beef, sesame, garlic, lemon, and black pepper for a complex umami profile.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Chicken Dashi Shoyu Ramen from Hokkaido features a light yet savory broth with a distinctive free-range chicken and soy sauce flavor, noted to be a touch on the saltier side. It comes complete with chicken meat, egg, and green onion, providing a flavorful and well-rounded instant noodle bowl.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban instant ramen offers a smooth noodle texture in a mellow, slightly creamy salt and seafood broth with an easy-to-eat seafood flavor. It's distinctive for its inclusion of cute Pikachu kamaboko and corn, making for a colorful and family-friendly dish.

This Japanese cup noodle from Sapporo Ichiban offers a distinctive, rich chicken broth infused with a prominent coriander flavor. Its well-textured noodles are complemented by bits of cabbage, chicken, and fresh coriander, making for a satisfying and aromatic cup.

variety: Cup Star Batman Garlic Shrimp Aji
description: This Japanese instant cup noodle, the Batman Garlic Shrimp Aji, features a savory shrimp and rich garlic broth with a subtle black pepper warmth. A distinctive element is its fun, al dente Batman-shaped fish cakes, offering a unique texture alongside the standard noodles.

This Japanese Cup Star Curry Udon offers especially curvy udon noodles with a decent chew, bathed in a thick, balanced sweet and spicy broth built on a seafood stock and 17 spices. Distinctive notes come from seasoned fried tofu and included meaty bits.
This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Cup Star Miso Ramen offers a pleasant miso broth complemented by nice meaty bits, though its noodles tend to be a little on the soggy side.

This Japanese CupStar instant tonkotsu ramen, inspired by Fukuoka, delivers a rich, creamy pork bone broth infused with shoyu, garlic, and ginger, perfectly paired with thin, satisfyingly chewy noodles and savory bits of pork and vegetables.

This Japanese CupStar instant noodle features a pretty good broth with a distinctive sweet and chicken barbecue flavor. Its noodles are noted to be spongy after three minutes, suggesting an extra minute of preparation could yield an ideal texture.

This Japanese instant ramen offers a classic Sapporo Ichiban Cupstar Shoyu experience, featuring a pleasant soy sauce broth enriched with scrambled eggs, kamaboko, and decent shrimp, though its good quality noodles present a distinctly chewy texture.

This Japanese CupStar ramen offers a gentle, umami-rich chicken broth, artfully reproducing Hakata's local Mizutaki hot pot flavor with notes of condensed chicken, vegetables, kelp, and bonito, all complemented by thick, voluminous noodles.

This Japanese CupStar noodle features a savory red miso broth with well-hydrated, non-soggy noodles and generous garnish. Its unique inclusion of Hokkaido potato offers an interesting, albeit perhaps unexpected, textural and flavor dimension.
This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Kitsune Udon features thick, broad noodles in a decent, not-overly-fishy bonito broth, subtly sweetened by fried tofu and complemented by pieces of scramble egg.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Potato Butter Shio Ramen features a distinctively rich and buttery chicken-shio broth with nicely textured noodles and slightly chunky potatoes, accented by corn, cabbage, and carrots. It offers a comforting and savory flavor profile highlighting its namesake ingredients.
This classic Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Shio Ramen delivers well-hydrated noodles in a savory salt-based broth, offering a straightforward and reliably satisfying instant noodle experience.
This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Shrimp Tensoba is distinguished by a rich, subtly sweet shrimp-flavored broth, though its most notable feature is the inclusion of shell-on shrimp pieces.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Tonkotsu features a hearty, Kyuushuu-style pork broth with a distinctive herbal note. It combines thin, straight noodles with generous chunks of tasty dried pork, wood ear mushrooms, sesame seeds, and green onions.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban CupStar Tonkotsu Ramen features an extremely good, creamy pork bone broth as its standout element, though the noodles and included meat may benefit from steeping slightly longer than the recommended time for optimal hydration.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Curry Ramen Donburi features thick, chewy noodles in a creamy, rich Japanese curry broth. The soup is distinguished by its umami blend of chicken, beef, and vegetables, subtly sweet, and spiced rather than spicy, leaving a mellow, lingering flavor.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Double Wasabi Yakisoba features noodles with a light, fluffy texture and a tasty, subtly wasabi-infused sauce. Despite its name, the flavor delivers a pleasant mildness rather than an intensely strong wasabi punch.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Fujiro Tonkotsu Shoyu Ramen features thick, chewy noodles in a milky, creamy shoyu tonkotsu broth accented with garlic. Abundant cabbage is a standout ingredient, significantly enhancing the overall flavor of this Mount Fuji-inspired cup noodle.

variety: Garlic Butter Style Shio Karubi Yakisoba
description: This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban yakisoba offers soft, plentiful noodles in just two minutes, delivering a distinctive garlic butter flavor expertly balanced with savory beef ribs and juicy pork soboro, highlighted by simple salt seasoning.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Ginza Curry cup noodle offers a robust, distinctive Japanese curry broth that, while flavorful, is noted for being overly salty. The accompanying noodles are generally adequate, and the cup contains pork and chicken.

variety: Hakata Junjo Shin Shin Tonkotsu Ramen
description: This Sapporo Ichiban Hakata Junjo Shin Shin Tonkotsu ramen from Japan features wispy thin, Hakata-style noodles immersed in an excellent, thick, and milky pork broth, capturing the classic creamy flavor of Fukuoka.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Hakata Mentaiko Tonkotsu Ramen offers spongy noodles in a thick, creamy pork bone broth that elevates beyond traditional tonkotsu with a unique chowdery, chicken-like comfort, distinctive for its inclusion of cod roe.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban cup ramen delivers a rich, savory broth infused with Hokkaido snow crab extract, built on a soy sauce and kelp base reminiscent of traditional Kanisuki hot pot. Its deeply flavorful soup is even suggested for transforming into a post-meal rice porridge.

Sapporo Ichiban's Japanese Ise Ebi Soup Noodles is a distinctive cup ramen offering a deeply rich and oily broth with a pronounced, somewhat musty deep-sea flavor, inspired by the Ise-ebi (spiny lobster) miso soup from Mie prefecture, and containing actual bits of spiny lobster and vegetables.

This Japanese Curry Ramen from Sapporo Ichiban offers a rich and balanced broth, marrying deep beef, onion, garlic, and miso notes with a distinctive curry-sweetness punch. This Japanese-style bowl features satisfying, non-spongy noodles and a mix of garnishes, highlighted by signature diced potatoes, delivering a hearty experience.

This Japanese Sapporo-style miso ramen, inspired by the celebrated Junren shop, features thick, wonderfully chewy noodles in a rich yet balanced pork bone broth with bold, tangy red miso notes, complemented by a generous inclusion of minced pork.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban cup noodle offers a distinctive savory experience, combining a rich, garlicky soy sauce broth with the umami of fried chicken. It features actual karaage toppings, complemented by cabbage, scallions, and flavored agedama, creating an appetizing and complete instant ramen.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Karaage Ginger Shio instant cup noodle delivers a distinctive chicken and ginger shio broth, noted for its nice chicken taste with prominent ginger notes. It features slightly spongy noodles, complemented by good quality included vegetables and small chicken pieces.

variety: Kasahara’s Specialty Katsuo & Meat Infused Adult Shoyu Ramen
description: This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban shoyu ramen, targeted at a more mature palate, offers a distinctive broth deeply infused with dashi, beef, and chili pepper, providing a complex umami and savory spice that pairs with its standard noodles.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Kumamoto Tonkotsu ramen offers a rich, thick pork bone broth distinguished by the aromatic notes of burnt garlic chips and mo-yu (burnt sesame oil and garlic). It features chewy noodles that hold up well, creating a satisfying texture against the flavorful broth.

variety: Kite Kyusju Moji Harbor Cheese Curry Ramen
description: Inspired by Fukuoka's Moji-Harbor Yaki Curry, this Japanese cup ramen from Sapporo Ichiban presents a distinctive broth where spicy curry meets mellow cheese. It features seasoned noodles crafted to blend seamlessly with the unique cheesy curry flavor.
This Japanese Kitsune Udon features thick noodles with a light chew, complemented by a notably tangy broth containing decent-sized vegetable pieces for a straightforward, likely meat-free experience.

This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban instant ramen offers a distinctive smoked chicken flavor, built on an aged soy sauce and simple chicken broth base with aromatic vegetables and black sesame. It features durable, flexible noodles complemented by ingredients like ground chicken, scrambled eggs, cabbage, and red bell pepper.

This Japanese instant ramen from Sapporo Ichiban, inspired by Tokyo's Kurenai shop, features a thick, rich, and savory broth combining red and white miso with a pleasing spiciness. Its distinctive texture comes from two noodle types, with different widths designed to mimic fresh chopped ramen shop noodles.

variety: Kuze Fuku & Co. Everyday Dashi Japanese Miso Ramen
description: This Japanese Dashi Miso Ramen features thick noodles in a semi-thick, dashi-infused miso broth that delivers a lighter-than-expected yet flavorful profile. It is distinctively complemented by meatballs, shiitake mushrooms, and onion.

variety: Kuze Fuku & Co. Everyday Dashi Shio Ramen
description: This Japanese Dashi Shio Ramen features a mellow, umami-rich broth, blending a classic salt base with dashi, chicken, pork, and prominent seafood notes. It comes with thin, satisfyingly chewy noodles and is distinctive for its generous amount of cabbage, offering a traditional Japanese taste.

variety: Kuze Fuku & Co. Everyday Dashi Shoyu Ramen
description: This Japanese Dashi Shoyu ramen from Nagano's Kuze Fuku & Co. is a cup noodle featuring well-hydrated noodles. Its distinctive broth offers a strong bonito-heavy dashi and shoyu umami, described as akin to tempura soba, and is complemented by nice pork bits.

variety: Kuze Fuku Mainichi Yasai Dashi Shio Ramen
description: This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban cup noodle offers a distinctively fragrant and savory shio ramen experience, featuring a unique vegetable dashi that provides a deep umami to its light broth. It's perfectly paired with thinner noodles and a generous assortment of cabbage, bean sprouts, kikurage mushrooms, and carrots.

variety: Min-Min Ramen Shop Hachoji Shoyu Ramen
description: This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban cup ramen offers the distinctive Hachoji Shoyu Ramen experience from Min-Min Ramen Shop. Expect a clear, savory soy sauce broth, characteristic of the Hachoji style, often highlighted by aromatic oil and diced onions.
This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban Miso Ramen in a cup offers a savory broth, enhanced by flavorful bits, and complemented by surprisingly good noodles for an instant variety.

This Japanese Sapporo Miso Ramen offers a classic regional experience with its rich, pork-based broth that boasts a balanced, deep miso flavor and a pleasant oiliness, alongside satisfyingly chewy noodles. It's distinctively topped with highlights of sweet corn and savory ground meat.

These additions create a notably thick, oily, and creamy soup, elevating the classic miso flavor with a satisfyingly robust texture.

It's further complemented by a generous mix of scrambled eggs, fresh green onions, and wakame seaweed, delivering a satisfying and distinctive ramen experience.
Sapporo Ichiban's Japanese instant noodles offer a classic, comforting experience with a rich and savory miso soybean paste broth, delivering a distinct umami flavor.

description: This Japanese Sapporo Ichiban instant shio ramen features a light-chew, standard-gauge noodle and a classic broth, uniquely enhanced by a "Wonder Powder" that adds a prominent, initially appealing tomato-umami flavor to the soup.

This Japanese cup noodle delivers an Omurice-inspired experience, featuring flexible, supple noodles in a savory chicken and vegetable broth uniquely sweetened by a prominent tomato flavor, dotted with scrambled eggs and green peas.

variety: Waraa Kagoshima Pork Shabu-Shabu Taste Ramen
description: This Japanese instant ramen, inspired by Kagoshima pork shabu-shabu, offers a soy sauce-based broth with deep richness from local black pork and umami from bonito and kelp. variety: Watanabe Yuichiro Specialty Mussel Mariniere Shio Ramen
description: This Japanese instant ramen presents a distinctive shio broth inspired by French mussel marinière, featuring rich, buttery notes and deep scallop umami alongside a satisfying seafood character, all complemented by chewy noodles.

description: This American Nissin Big Cup Noodle features broad, egg-like noodles in a distinctive, zesty lime-forward broth, delivering a flavor reminiscent of Flamin' Hot Lime Cheetos and a citrusy, Tom Yum-like quality, with underlying chili and shrimp notes.
This US-style Nissin Big Cup Noodles Roast Chicken offers tasty, egg-noodle-like ramen in a lighter broth that some may wish was thicker and had a stronger roast chicken flavor.

This US-made Nissin Big Cup Noodles Shrimp offers a distinctive drained noodle experience, featuring a balanced and mellow lemony, habanero-spiced flavor with savory notes of shrimp. It boasts a satisfying whole wheat-like noodle texture and comes with good quality included vegetables, all coated in its flavorful sauce.

This Nissin Big Cup Noodles Spicy Chicken, an Indian-style product, features distinctive noodles with a unique filminess and subtle crumble, served in a rich, gravy-like broth. It offers a very good masala flavor, creating a satisfyingly savory and spicy profile.

This US-made Nissin Bowl Noodle offers a straightforward, pleasant chicken flavor with a clear aroma and savory broth. It features rehydrated corn, carrots, and greenery, while the noodles are noted to be a bit crumbly.

This elegant prawn soup bowl features "legendary" noodles, lauded for their excellent firmness and chew. Its refined, not overly salty, prawn-flavored broth is enriched by a liquid soup base containing prawn, shrimp, and chicken for a delicate seafood taste.

This distinctive Nissin Singapore instant noodle offers a unique salted egg flavor with a notable bump of heat, served as a saucy, dry dish rather than a broth. It features wide, flat noodles with a very pleasing texture, and is topped with small, flavorful eggy bits.

variety: Bowl Noodles Hot & Spicy Chicken Flavor Less Sodium Ramen Noodle Soup
description: This US Nissin Hot & Spicy Chicken Bowl Noodle offers a distinctive 30% lower sodium experience. It features soft noodles in a very good, zesty broth, which gains thickness from a seasoned oil "Soup Booster" and includes a generous mix of hydrated vegetables, evoking the style of a Mexican instant noodle.
This US-style instant noodle, a Hot & Spicy Shrimp variety, is distinctive for its non-fried noodles that offer a high-fiber, lower-calorie profile within a convenient bowl format.

variety: Bowl Noodles Hot & Spicy Super Picante
description: This US-style Nissin Bowl Noodle, the Hot & Spicy Super Picante, offers a rich, spicy, and earthy broth, complemented by thin, slightly crumbly noodles. It stands out with a good amount of vegetables, particularly well-rehydrated corn, adding to its distinctive flavor profile.

This Hong Kong-style Nissin instant noodle offers a rich, savory beef broth notably enhanced by real diced pork and a fragrant sesame oil, a distinct feature from its US counterparts. It boasts soft, round noodles with a slight sponginess, complemented by bits of egg and spring onion for a satisfying chew.

This Nissin instant noodle features satisfyingly chewy noodles in a distinctive Hong Kong-style curry broth. Its flavor offers a nuanced British curry taste with a light peppery edge, setting it apart from sweeter Japanese curries, and delivers a mild, pleasant spiciness.

This US-style instant Chow Mein stands out with its slightly broad, flat noodles offering a satisfying consistency, all coated in a savory, non-sweet chicken teriyaki sauce and complemented by well-plumped vegetables.
This US-style Nissin Chow Mein delivers a distinctive saucy noodle experience, featuring flat, thick noodles with a prominent and savory chicken flavor, accented by cabbage.

This US-style Nissin Chow Mein Chinese Chicken Vegetable offers firm, satisfying noodles with a distinctive sesame oil flavor, subtle chicken notes, and a very light spiciness. It's generously complemented by a colorful array of well-rehydrated vegetables.

This US-made Nissin Chow Mein Kung Pao Chicken offers a distinctively savory, mildly spiced instant noodle experience. It features neat noodles that maintain separation and provide a good mouthfeel, served in a sauced (not soupy) format, and appears to be meat-free.

This Nissin Singapore Cup Noodle offers an adaptation of the iconic Chilli Crab, featuring a semi-thick, sweet and savory tomato and chili-based sauce that, while not overtly spicy, aims to capture the sensuous and fluffy texture of the original Singaporean seafood dish.

This US-style Nissin Chow Mein Pad Thai features flat, well-textured noodles designed to be saucy rather than brothy. Its Americanized Pad Thai flavor profile is savory with hints of sesame or peanut, and the dish contains shrimp as an ingredient.

variety: Chow Mein Premium Savory Sauce And Restaurant Quality Noodles Sriracha Flavor
description: This US-made Nissin Chow Mein offers a distinctive Sriracha flavor, echoing the common American-style hot sauce with its blend of chili peppers, distilled vinegar, garlic, sugar, and salt in a sauced noodle dish.

variety: Chow Mein Savory Sauce And Restayrant Quality Noodles Roast Chicken Flavor
description: This US-style Nissin Chow Mein tray features soft, comfort-food textured noodles coated in a distinctive, savory roast chicken flavored sauce. It delivers a strong, salty, and oily profile reminiscent of rotisserie chicken, offering a richly satisfying chicken noodle experience.

This US-based Nissin Chow Mein Spicy Chicken tray delivers a distinctively saucy, "sloppy" noodle texture with a satisfying mouthfeel. Its flavor profile is a peculiar blend, drawing comparisons to Hamburger Helper combined with ramen, and is finished with a separate "fire sauce" sachet for its spicy element.

This tray-style Nissin Chow Mein from the United States offers a distinctive spicy teriyaki beef flavor, combining a sweet teriyaki base with a well-integrated spiciness. It features plentiful, springy noodles and included vegetables like corn, all coated in a unique and flavorful savory-sweet glaze.

variety: Chow Mein Spicy Teriyaki Beef Flavor
description: This American-style instant Chow Mein from Nissin delivers a distinctive beef flavor, elevated by sweet teriyaki notes and a hint of spice. Its plentiful, thin, flat noodles have a slightly crumbly texture, all coated in a savory sauce with visible vegetables.

variety: Chow Mein Teiyaki Chicken Chow Mein Noodles
description: This US-style Nissin Chow Mein Teriyaki Chicken features nicely hydrated noodles with a pleasing slight crumble, coated in a distinctly sweet chicken-flavored sauce. Its standout ingredients include green beans, carrots, and bok choy, which are described as quite good.
This United States tray-style instant noodle is distinguished by its exceptionally chewy noodles, though the broth itself is described as quite light on flavor despite a pleasant oiliness.

variety: Chow Mein Teriyaki Beef Flavor Chow Mein Noodles
description: This American-style instant chow mein from Nissin features a distinctly sweet teriyaki beef flavor profile complemented by included vegetables, offering noodles that are a bit toothsome but also noted for their brittleness.

variety: Chow Mein Teriyaki Chicken Flavor Chow Mein Noodles
description: This US-style Nissin Teriyaki Chicken Chow Mein offers flat, agreeably chewy noodles enveloped in a thick, full-flavored teriyaki sauce that provides a savory twist on traditional sweet teriyaki. A "melange" of solid ingredients enhances its ever-present and distinct teriyaki chicken flavor.

variety: Chow Mein Teriyaki Vegetable Flavor Chow Mein Noodles
description: This U.S.-made Nissin Teriyaki Vegetable Chow Mein, packaged in a convenient tray, offers a distinctive sweet and savory teriyaki flavor unlike traditional meat varieties. It features flat, soft noodles with a pleasant chew, perfectly complemented by nicely hydrated vegetables and a flavorful sauce.

Nissin's US-made Thai Peanut Chow Mein features thin, pleasingly firm noodles accompanied by a distinct, well-balanced sauce. Its flavor profile is highlighted by a notable sour bite from black vinegar, complementing its savory, peanut-inspired base.

variety: Chow Mein With Shrimp Chow Mein Noodles
description: Nissin's American-style Shrimp Chow Mein features slightly wide, flat noodles with a light chew and a prominent shrimp, garlic, and seasoning salt flavor profile, all coated in a welcomed slightly greasy seasoning oil alongside included shrimp and vegetables.
This Otafuku instant udon offers thick, standard Japanese udon noodles paired with a distinctly sweet and flavorful sukiyaki sauce, ideal for a satisfying stir-fry preparation.

This Nissin instant noodle from the United States, presented in a convenient tray, offers a unique take on instant spaghetti with noodles slightly softer than standard pasta, complemented by a distinctly sweet tomato-based sauce.

This Nissin Chow Noodles Tomato Basil, a flavorful instant noodle in a convenient bowl, features round gauge noodles with a soft, slightly spongy chew. It delivers a distinct blend of tangy tomato and aromatic basil, enhanced by a strong sesame-scented broth and garnished with egg bits and spring onion.
This Nissin instant noodle offers tender, perfectly cooked rice vermicelli in a savory braised beef broth, uniquely accented by an oil sachet's almost artificial chicken scent.
